result.fix: Change the line for `vm.max_map_count` in `/etc/sysctl.conf` to `vm.max_map_count = 262144`. Then run `sysctl --system` to apply the files. `sysctl -p` does not read `sysctl.d`.
result.message: `vm.max_map_count` is `262144`, as needed, but `/etc/sysctl.conf` sets it to `65530` at boot, so a reboot changes it.
notes: Read 2 sysctl configuration file(s), in boot order.
`/etc/sysctl.conf` is read by `sysctl --system`. The boot service, systemd-sysctl, reads it only when a file in a sysctl.d directory links to it, so put the setting in `/etc/sysctl.d/` to be sure.
